content.title: New York Mets vs Houston Astros Live Stream: How to Watch MLB Spring Training
content.text: The Houston Astros will take on the New York Mets in MLB spring training on Saturday night in Florida. The New York Mets will be the road team in this Grapefruit League spring training game against the Houston Astros at CACTI Park of the Palm Beaches on Saturday night in Florida. The Mets are contending for the lead in the Grapefruit League through 16 games, No. 5 in the league, two games behind four teams tied at the top. On Thursday, their game ended in a 3-1 road loss against the St. Louis Cardinals, led by a home run from second baseman Jorge Polanco, who went 1-for-3 on the night at the plate. Sean Manaea started the game and went 2.2 innings, allowing six hits with three earned runs and four strikeouts with the loss. Four players finished the game with 5.1 total innings, led by Tobias Myers, who allowed one hit over three innings with two strikeouts.
